description: wodgik.opolskie.pl: flood hazard datasets (zdjecia powodz) is a collection of datasets listed in Geoportal Opole Province, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by wodgik.opolskie.pl. Coverage: the area served by wodgik.opolskie.pl. The listing groups 313 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, panchromatyczne, szereg 13, zdjęcie 3312; Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, RGB, M-33-48-6789; Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, panchromatyczne, szereg 16, zdjęcie 3651; Zdjęcia „Powódź 1997”, panchromatyczne, szereg 13, zdjęcie 3620. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opole.
